description: This Java class defines a command to enable connection logs within a connectivity management system, part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for serialization/deserialization from JSON, and encapsulates the connection ID to specify which connection's logging is to be enabled.

classes.name: EnableConnectionLogs
classes.description: Immutable command class to enable logging for a specific connection in a connectivity system, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization, and integrating with the Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new EnableConnectionLogs instance with specified connection ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes JSON string or object into an EnableConnectionLogs instance.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload to a JSON object during serialization, including the connection ID.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, in this case MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, here the command path.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Equality check based on connection ID and superclass.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on connection ID and superclass.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the command including connection ID.
